name: unfold
description: Linear chart writer — logs a decision at the moment the direction changes, collapses an accumulated open set into axes that each name what they absorbed, and closes a unit with its structure delta, closing note, and a letter of introduction for the follow-up, and sorts the Triage inbox into the charts it belongs to; asks rather than infers what the user settled, reads the unit's chart before the first write, and writes only structure and decisions, never progress
